jvmMaxMemoryPctAllowedRange.description:
The permitted range for the {@link App.NodePool.JvmSpec#jvmMaxMemoryPct}
Value of -1 indicates there are no limits.

jvmMaxMemoryPct.description:
Refers to the the maximum fraction (0-1) of a node's memory to be reserved for C3 server's JVM. This corresponds to
the computation for the max Java heap size to be allocated.

enableHeapDumpOnOomError.description: A flag to enable JVM heap dump on out of memory error.

heapDumpPath.description: Refers to the path where the heap dump file will be generated in case of an out of memory error.

numVertxWorkers.description: Refers to the number of vertx workers to be used for this {@link App.NodePool}.

title: Configuration options for JVM related configurations for {@link App.NodePool}.
